hooks.text: 用单机玩法模拟中式网游氪金压制，但充值不消耗现实金钱
hooks.excerpt: This game aims to restore the Chinese style of online games where players can recharge without spending real money, and let players experience the fun of "kelao"!(This is a single player game.)
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 10 多个结局由疯狂氪金称霸或稳健发展恋爱等路线决定
hooks.excerpt: There are about 10+ different endings for different experiences! Do you want to recharge like crazy and become the lord of the Imperial City? Or do you want to develop steadily and get a beautiful woman? It's your choice!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 缺钱结婚的老王被明星代言网游广告吸引，由此卷入命运转折
hooks.excerpt: The player will play the role of an older unmarried young man Lao Wang, because of the lack of money for marriage in thinking of ways to accidentally be attracted by the pop-up ads of an online game endorsed by a certain celebrity, and the gears of destiny began to turn at that moment.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
